channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Payton Pritchard | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Payton Pritchard from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Joe Mazzulla on Payton Pritchard
item.description:
Joe Mazzulla on Payton Pritchard a day after agreeing to his contract extension:

“When people think of a Celtic, he’s one of the first people that comes to mind.”

Joe Mazzulla on Payton Pritchard, Oct 14, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Payton Pritchard
item.description:
Jaylen Brown:

“Payton’s been big time. We call him Big Shot Bob around here. He just makes timely plays, timely baskets. Those rebounds are big for us. His development has been great as well. Sometimes it has fallen under the radar with all the other guys that we have, but Payton has been very significant to our success. Tonight was an example of that. In his minutes, he just won every little play, and on top of that, made some big shots. Big-time game from Payton.”

Jaylen Brown on Payton Pritchard, Apr 27, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Joe Mazzulla on Malcolm Brogdon, Payton Pritchard
item.description:
Mazzulla on two Celtics winning 6MOY of the year recently:

“It's a tough thing coming off the bench, especially for Malcolm, who was a starter ...it's tough for Payton too ... when you have a locker room like those guys, you want to do stuff for the guy next to you.”

Joe Mazzulla on Malcolm Brogdon, Payton Pritchard, Apr 23, 2025. Source: Twitter @RealBobManning.

item.title: Jamahl Mosley on Derrick White, Payton Pritchard, Jaylen Brown, Jayson Tatum
item.description:
Mason Williams:Jamahl Mosley on the #Magic’s defense against Jayson Tatum and Jaylen Brown:

“I think we did a very good job on those guys. Made it tough on them, made it difficult for them to get easy shots. For the most part, it was the Derrick White’s .. the Payton Pritchard’s… two guys you don’t really account for coming up with 49 points. I think we’ve got to do a better job there.”

Jamahl Mosley on Derrick White, Payton Pritchard, Jaylen Brown, Jayson Tatum, Apr 20, 2025. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Payton Pritchard
item.description:
Jared Weiss:Jaylen Brown on Payton Pritchard:

“He’s put in the work to garner people’s respect…On the court, when he’s got it going, I take my butt to the corner and Payton’s running the show.”

Jaylen Brown on Payton Pritchard, Dec 3, 2024. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Payton Pritchard
item.description:
Jack Simone:Jaylen Brown on Payton Pritchard:

“Payton's definitely been in my bag, man, for sure. Got my shoes on. I'm gonna take my joints back. He definitely getting the up-fakes, the post moves. He's definitely been expanding his game, and I love to see it.”

Jaylen Brown on Payton Pritchard, Dec 3, 2024. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Al Horford on Luke Kornet, Payton Pritchard, Sam Hauser, Baylor Scheierman, Jordan Walsh
item.description:
“Our guys, everybody just getting in, trying to get better. I think that Sam Hauser, Luke Kornet, but then Payton Pritchard. I mean, Payton is setting the tone. He looks really good. All our young guys as well, Jordan Walsh, Baylor (Scheierman). Baylor has looked pretty impressive in these days, but everybody’s just really committed to putting in the work and getting after it, and the rest of us, obviously, we’ve been in there too and it’s just been nice to see everybody in there working back together and kind of turning the page and getting ready for this season.”

Al Horford on Luke Kornet, Payton Pritchard, Sam Hauser, Baylor Scheierman, Jordan Walsh, Sep 23, 2024. Source: CLNSMedia.com.

item.title: Joe Mazzulla on Payton Pritchard
item.description:
Joe Mazzulla on Payton Pritchard’s extension:

“Most guys in his position, the league breaks them…He’s not one of those guys. So he continues to be a tough SOB for us and I’m happy I continue to coach him this year.”

Joe Mazzulla on Payton Pritchard, Oct 8, 2023. Source: Twitter @JaredWeissNBA.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Payton Pritchard
item.description:
Brad Stevens on Payton Pritchard's situation with Celtics:

“I really feel for a guy like him. He's a really good player.”

Brad Stevens on Payton Pritchard, Jun 1, 2023. Source: Twitter @BrianTRobb.

item.title: Joe Mazzulla on Payton Pritchard
item.description:
Jared Weiss:Joe Mazzulla on Payton Pritchard, who said he was hoping he got traded for a bigger opportunity:

“I love Payton. I’m happy Payton is expressing himselfand the honestly that he speaks with.”

Joe Mazzulla on Payton Pritchard, Feb 12, 2023. Source: Twitter @JaredWeissNBA.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Payton Pritchard
item.description:
Chris Grenham:Brad Stevens on Payton Pritchard:

“He helped us get back in the game. ... Payton was a big reason why we were able to get back in.”

Brad Stevens on Payton Pritchard, Feb 7, 2021. Source: Twitter @chrisgrenham.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Payton Pritchard
item.description:
Chris Grenham:Brad Stevens on Payton Pritchard:

“He's tough. He knows how to play. He's physical, he can shoot the ball. He's certainly had a good couple of days. ... That's why he was picked in the first round and is a good player.”

Brad Stevens on Payton Pritchard, Dec 10, 2020. Source: Twitter @chrisgrenham.
